entity.summary: Self-custodial cryptocurrency wallet application published by Bitcoin.com for managing supported digital assets.
entity.notes: Current Bitcoin.com support and legal material explicitly states that the wallet is self-custodial and Bitcoin.com does not take custody of wallet assets. Initial wallet launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Bitcoin.com self-custodial mobile wallet application for supported cryptocurrency assets.
products.notes: Current app boundary is established by Bitcoin.com support material. Exact original app launch date remains unresolved.

evidence.title: Wallet Service Terms
evidence.notes: Bitcoin.com wallet terms state that the wallet software permits users to self-custody virtual currency and that Bitcoin.com does not take custody.

evidence.title: Cryptocurrency security
evidence.notes: Current Bitcoin.com support explicitly identifies the Bitcoin.com Wallet app as self-custodial with user-controlled keys.

evidence.title: Bitcoin.com Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party Bitcoin.com Wallet page distributes the mobile app and documents active wallet functionality, supporting a maintained mobile product state.
